summary: Master Simultaneous Operations (SIMOPS) for onshore and offshore facilities. Learn to develop MOPOs, Bridging Documents, and PTW systems. Enroll today.
lede: SIMOPS training helps coordinators, HSE managers, supervisors and other professionals plan and control overlapping work around live operations. It covers assessing hazards across clashing tasks, building a Matrix of Permitted Operations, and coordinating permit-to-work controls. Participants also learn to map interfaces and align emergency arrangements for simultaneous activities.
audienceIntro: This comprehensive training is engineered for professionals responsible for planning, authorizing, and executing overlapping activities in high-risk industrial environments.
modules: Permit to Work (PTW) and Isolation Controls
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 3 years of experience in oil and gas, heavy construction, or maritime operations, with a working knowledge of Permit to Work (PTW) systems and basic risk assessment methodologies. No advanced engineering degree is required, but familiarity with facility operations and safety management systems is essential for engaging with the practical exercises.
